names.note: Read out of the name link behind days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 5 августа ст. ст., «Мцц. Евдокии , Дарии , Дарии и Марии (1919).», which gives the forename alone and in the genitive; the name link's nominative is «Мария (Неизвестная), мц.», where «мц.» is a rank and «Неизвестная» is the Russian word for unknown rather than a surname, so the stored form is the bare forename and the parenthesis is reported and not kept.

death.note: The one year the day line gives the four of them together, «(1919)». There is no life page behind the line.
